title: S00 — Class name
_readme: Drop this file as questions.json into a session folder (e.g. s02/questions.json)
and run: presik s02. Full contract — CONVENTIONS.md.
choice — options; more than one can be correct: "correct": true
text   — free-form answer (cold open, exit ticket)
widget — your own interactive front-end (a form, a game) in a sandboxed
iframe on the phone; set "answer" to choice|scale|text — it is
validated/revealed/archived as that kind. See CONVENTIONS.md.
explain — shown to students after reveal (both on slides and on /host)
hint    — visible ONLY TO YOU, on /host: what to do with the result
slide   — the 1-based slide/page this question appears after, in your deck
(deck.marp.md or deck.pdf). Omit it to keep a question off the
slides (still runnable from /host). No deck? slide is ignored.
id      — optional; generated as <session>-q<N> if omitted

questions.text: Opening question: what do you think ...?
questions.note: There's no correct answer yet. Write what you think.
questions.hint: Don't comment on answers now. Come back to these at the end.
questions.explain: We'll come back to this at the end of class.

options.text: The most commonly picked wrong option

questions.explain: Why the correct answer is what it is.
questions.hint: If most picked a — that means X. Go back to Y.

questions.text: How confident do you feel about this topic right now?
questions.hint: Average below 3 — don't move on, go back to the basics.

questions.note: Anonymous. (No "slide", so it only runs from /host — e.g. an exit ticket.)
questions.hint: Read before the next class. Common themes — opener for next time.

questions.text: Tap the gate you'd leave the maze by.
questions.note: An interactive question. The whole front-end is inline in "srcdoc" — a real game can live here too, or point "src" at a bundle file. It reports one option id, graded like a choice question.
questions.explain: The east gate was the only one without a dead end.
questions.hint: If many pick north — they missed the map on slide 2.
